superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim Observerove razdvojene razmake između prijema u dokaz da se sam grad menja asinhrono: to su starosti prijema, a SEPA i Parking Servis ne daju vreme merenja. Connectorova tačka poređenja ostaje privremena: prikazana promena sa 301 na 187 u Pionirskom parku ne utvrđuje ni istovremene promene drugde ni uzrok. [F2][F4][F5][F6]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot turn Observer's separated reception gaps into evidence that the city itself is changing asynchronously: these are reception ages, and SEPA and Parking Servis provide no measurement time [F2][F4][F5]. Connector's comparison target remains provisional: the displayed move from 301 to 187 at Pionirski park establishes neither simultaneous changes elsewhere nor a cause [F6].
questions_sr: Da li bi promene na okolnim parkiralištima opstale pri poređenju tokom usklađenih intervala merenja? [F6]
